questions.question_text: What is a key way to inspire others through positive examples as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: Giving long speeches about success
Demonstrating resilience and integrity in your actions
Telling peers what they should do to improve
Focusing only on your own achievements

correct_answer.text: Demonstrating resilience and integrity in your actions

questions.question_text: Why is specific praise more effective than generic compliments when offering encouragement?

options.text: It sounds more professional
It shows you’re paying attention to their unique efforts
It takes less time to say
It makes you seem more authoritative

correct_answer.text: It shows you’re paying attention to their unique efforts

questions.question_text: What is a recommended strategy for offering guidance to a peer who is struggling?

options.text: Tell them exactly how to solve their problem
Focus on their mistakes to help them learn
Suggest solutions while encouraging them to find their own way
Avoid giving advice so they don’t feel pressured

correct_answer.text: Suggest solutions while encouraging them to find their own way

questions.question_text: What does the chapter identify as a core component of empathy in peer-to-peer coaching?

options.text: Solving problems for your peer quickly
Understanding and acknowledging their emotions and perspective
Telling them how you would handle their situation
Keeping conversations short to avoid discomfort

correct_answer.text: Understanding and acknowledging their emotions and perspective

questions.question_text: How can active listening help in building empathy with a peer, according to the chapter?

options.text: It shows you’re in a hurry to move on to solutions
It allows you to interrupt with helpful advice
It demonstrates that you’re fully engaged and value their thoughts
It helps you avoid asking too many questions

correct_answer.text: It demonstrates that you’re fully engaged and value their thoughts

questions.question_text: What should you do if a peer shares a personal struggle during a coaching conversation?

options.text: Share your own story immediately to relate to them
Promise to keep it confidential and avoid judgment
Suggest they talk to someone else for help
Change the topic to make them feel more comfortable

correct_answer.text: Promise to keep it confidential and avoid judgment
